cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Keep your coat off. The prophecy says this bell-less tower will ring at noon; I need a witness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then sign that before you go. We can officially stop waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me four more minutes. I'll fill in our names so only the silence needs witnessing.

mechanism: A claims expert control of witness timing and record accuracy while keeping B until a bell-less tower's prediction can be tested.
confusable: Ordinary clock correction is not enough; the correction must keep the person present for the impossible prediction's outcome.
comparison: A shared four-minute clock adjustment differs from renegotiating Gran's undated prophecy.
seedUse: Use fast watch arithmetic and silence witness; direct corrections at timing rather than the generic standard.
